Name: Flower Guard
Author: jaericknexus
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Avoid accidental flower picking! Protects flowers from harvest while collecting honey by making flowers within range of a bee house un-harvestable[/color].

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip to Stardew's Mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Makes flowers within range of a bee house un-harvestable[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extended custom range for larger flower fields with nearby hives[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Toggle to view affected range while holding beekeeping-related items (flower seeds, bee house, or honey) for 10, 20, or 30 minutes (must hold item through a clock tick); or a persistent overlay[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional toggle to allow harvesting with Iridium Scythe for easier end-of-season cleanup[/color][/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52017/52017-1789487977-133610219.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Optional in-game menu compatibility with GMCM[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Flower Guard
Manifest.Description: Stops you accidentally picking flowers that are feeding a nearby bee house while you collect honey.
Manifest.Author: littleguygreens
